_comment: MathMon encyclopedia (codex). Seen: concept, habitat, behaviour. Caught: relationships, history, role. Existing creatures are described as designed - nothing here renames or redesigns them.

FRACTELLA.concept: Fractions and equal parts: its body splits into perfectly equal pieces and rejoins.
FRACTELLA.habitat: Pine Ridge and Waterfall Plateau, near falling water that splits into streams.
FRACTELLA.behaviour: Cheerful and curious; shares everything evenly, even with strangers.
FRACTELLA.relationships: Gem-cousins with GEMELLA; wary of GEOMAX, whose stone can shatter crystal.
FRACTELLA.history: Tallyfolk children carried FRACTELLA to learn fair sharing.
FRACTELLA.role: A starter partner - and the first to sense when a seal has been tampered with.

PRISMELLA.concept: Ratio and proportion: every facet holds the same ratio of light.
PRISMELLA.habitat: Only where a FRACTELLA's trainer has mastered fractions.
PRISMELLA.behaviour: Calm and precise; refracts its feelings into colours.
PRISMELLA.relationships: The Prism Archive's light reacts to it like an old friend.
PRISMELLA.history: Euclidian stained glass shows PRISMELLA above every doorway.

GEOMAX.concept: Geometry and solid shape: a golem of stacked, square-cut stone.
GEOMAX.habitat: Green Meadow edges, the Sunsand Desert and the Ancient Number Ruins.
GEOMAX.behaviour: Slow, loyal and immovable once it decides to protect you.
GEOMAX.relationships: Shelters smaller MathMon in storms; quietly feuds with DIVOWL over roots.
GEOMAX.history: Tallyfolk used wild GEOMAX to measure out their first fields.
GEOMAX.role: A starter partner. Bram's Stone Charm was carved for its kind.

GEOMAXIMUS.concept: Layers of proof: each layer of stone rests on the one beneath.
GEOMAXIMUS.habitat: Wherever a GEOMAX's trainer has mastered geometry.
GEOMAXIMUS.behaviour: Patient and protective; it never moves without a reason.
GEOMAXIMUS.history: Euclidia's walls were modelled on its body.

NUMEREX.concept: Negative numbers: a shade of the space below zero.
NUMEREX.habitat: Mirror Beach and the Ancient Number Ruins, in shadows that fall below the ground line.
NUMEREX.relationships: Follows NULLSHADE at a distance; teases AQUABIT.
NUMEREX.history: The Tallyfolk believed NUMEREX kept count of what was lost.
NUMEREX.role: A starter partner. Its swollen boss form, the Arithmetic Beast, guarded the Arch of Sums.

NULLAREX.concept: The full number line in both directions.
NULLAREX.habitat: Wherever a NUMEREX's trainer has mastered integers.
NULLAREX.behaviour: Thoughtful; it drifts through the space below zero as easily as above it.
NULLAREX.relationships: Other dark MathMon calm down near it.
NULLAREX.history: No records describe it - it may be new to Mathea.

CHRONOX.concept: Sequences and algebra: a clockwork dragon that ticks in patterns.
CHRONOX.habitat: Rarely seen anywhere in Number Forest; it appears to learners who keep practising.
CHRONOX.behaviour: Proud, punctual, and fond of predicting what you'll do next.
CHRONOX.relationships: Bows to CHRONOWL; afraid of nothing except stopped clocks.
CHRONOX.history: The Timekeepers' young dragons wandered from Chronos long ago.
CHRONOX.role: A starter partner. It grows uneasy whenever you're near a clock showing 3:14.

CHRONODRAKE.concept: Rules of change: its gears keep time for a whole forest.
CHRONODRAKE.habitat: Wherever a CHRONOX's trainer has mastered algebra.
CHRONODRAKE.behaviour: Steady and wise; its heartbeat is a perfect metronome.
CHRONODRAKE.relationships: Keeper Tick bows when it passes.
CHRONODRAKE.history: The Great Clock's gears were once said to be a sleeping CHRONODRAKE.

PYRON.concept: Addition: a little sun-dragon whose fire grows by adding sparks.
PYRON.habitat: Green Meadow, Sunny Farms and the Sunsand Desert.
PYRON.behaviour: Bold and warm; it collects things in piles and counts them.
PYRON.relationships: Squabbles with AQUABIT, but they always make up.
PYRON.history: Farmers say a PYRON in the field means a good harvest count.
PYRON.role: Common wild MathMon of the forest.

AQUABIT.concept: Subtraction and below-zero: the minus mark on its shell shines when it thinks.
AQUABIT.habitat: Mirror Beach, the waterfalls and the Glow Tunnels.
AQUABIT.behaviour: Calm and careful; takes away only what it must.
AQUABIT.relationships: Best friends with PYRON, though neither will admit it.
AQUABIT.history: Fishermen in the village tell stories of AQUABIT returning lost nets.
AQUABIT.role: Common wild MathMon; plentiful in the Algebra Cavern's pools.

VOLTIX.concept: Multiplication: its tails spark in groups of three - 3, 6, 9, 12.
VOLTIX.habitat: Green Meadow, Pine Ridge and the bridges.
VOLTIX.relationships: Rex's partner of choice. Its crystal cousin is PRISMVOLT.
VOLTIX.history: The first glitching MathMon after the Counting Stone flickered was a VOLTIX.
VOLTIX.role: Rex's partner; common in the meadow.

DIVOWL.concept: Division: it shares every snack into equal piles.
DIVOWL.habitat: Green Meadow, Pine Ridge and the waterfalls.
DIVOWL.behaviour: Wise, fussy about fairness, and easily startled.
DIVOWL.relationships: Feuds with GEOMAX over tree roots; adores Tobi.
DIVOWL.history: Tallyfolk judges kept a DIVOWL to settle disputes fairly.
DIVOWL.role: Professor Numeris's practice partner. Tobi's DIVOWL, Sums, is lost.

GEMELLA.concept: Fractions of a whole: it chips away an exact fraction of itself with every bounce.
GEMELLA.habitat: Pine Ridge, the farms and the Ancient Number Ruins.
GEMELLA.behaviour: Bouncy and generous; regrows what it gives away.
GEMELLA.history: Gem fragments found in the ruins are GEMELLA shed-chips.

PRISMVOLT.concept: Multiplication in rows and columns of light.
PRISMVOLT.history: Formed where the First Axiom's shards met a VOLTIX's sparks.
PRISMVOLT.role: Wild MathMon of the Crystal Realm.

OPALOWL.concept: Division of light into equal beams.
OPALOWL.behaviour: Serene; it watches the stars and counts them in equal groups.
OPALOWL.history: Said to have guarded the Prism Archive since the world began.
OPALOWL.role: Wild MathMon of the Crystal Realm.

GRAPHION.concept: Lines and graphs: a clockwork comet that travels on straight lines.
GRAPHION.habitat: Starfall Garden - and only for those who complete the Star Chart.
GRAPHION.history: Older than the Crystal Realm itself, perhaps.

NUMEREX_BOSS.concept: Remainder in arithmetic: a NUMEREX swollen with numbers that never add up.
NUMEREX_BOSS.habitat: The Arch of Sums in the Ancient Number Ruins.
NUMEREX_BOSS.behaviour: Confused and furious - its pattern can't hold itself together.
NUMEREX_BOSS.history: Set over the forest seals by the Tallyfolk. Remainder was poured into it recently.

NULLSHADE.concept: Negative numbers and debts: a hooded shade from below zero.
NULLSHADE.habitat: The Glow Tunnels and Echo Hollow.
NULLSHADE.behaviour: Feeds on careless mistakes; harmless to careful trainers.
NULLSHADE.history: The Order of the Unknown used NULLSHADE to guard their ledgers.
NULLSHADE.role: Wild MathMon of the Algebra Cavern.

INFERMATH.concept: Algebra as fire: an equation that grows hotter each turn.
INFERMATH.habitat: The deep tunnels of the Algebra Cavern.
INFERMATH.behaviour: Fierce but fair - it respects anyone who solves for x.
INFERMATH.relationships: Its folded cousin became the Dimension Dragon.
INFERMATH.history: Order scholars warmed their labs with tame INFERMATH.
INFERMATH.role: Wild MathMon of the Algebra Cavern.

CRYSTALGON.concept: Exact angles: a golem whose every facet is cut precisely.
CRYSTALGON.habitat: The Garden and Pillar Courts of Euclidia.
CRYSTALGON.behaviour: Formal, protective, and offended by crooked lines.
CRYSTALGON.relationships: Serves Sir Hypot's family by tradition.
CRYSTALGON.history: Euclidia's builders used CRYSTALGON as living set-squares.
CRYSTALGON.role: Wild MathMon of the Geometry Kingdom.

VOLTBYTE.concept: Multiplication in stages: a robotic wolf that moves in multiples.
VOLTBYTE.behaviour: Hunts in packs of equal size.
VOLTBYTE.relationships: Distant kin to VOLTIX - a constructed copy, the Euclidians claimed.
VOLTBYTE.history: Built, not born: Euclidian engineers assembled the first VOLTBYTE.
VOLTBYTE.role: Wild MathMon of the Geometry Kingdom.

GALAXION.concept: Very large numbers: a griffin whose wings hold millions of stars.
GALAXION.habitat: The Pillar Court, under the open sky.
GALAXION.behaviour: Majestic and patient; counts the stars every night.
GALAXION.relationships: Rarely shares the sky with GRAPHION.
GALAXION.history: Euclidian astronomers used its wings as a star map.
GALAXION.role: Wild MathMon of the Geometry Kingdom.

MYCOMORPH.concept: Fractions and percentages: a spore-creature that breaks itself into fractional pieces.
MYCOMORPH.behaviour: Strange and gentle; it grows in exact proportions.
MYCOMORPH.relationships: Gardeners and GEMELLA both get along with it.
MYCOMORPH.history: Not an animal copy at all - one of the first truly abstract MathMon found.
MYCOMORPH.role: Wild MathMon of the Geometry Kingdom.

CHRONOWL.concept: Sequences: a solar owl that sees the next number of every pattern.
CHRONOWL.habitat: The Tick and Tock Isles of Chronos.
CHRONOWL.behaviour: Still as the frozen islands, until it predicts your move.
CHRONOWL.role: Wild MathMon of the Chronos Dimension.

HEXABYTE.concept: Powers and doubling: its venom doubles, and doubles, and doubles.
HEXABYTE.behaviour: Patient; it waits for growth to do the work.
HEXABYTE.history: Timekeepers used it to teach how fast doubling grows.
HEXABYTE.role: Wild MathMon of the Chronos Dimension.

SPHYNOX.concept: Logic and proportion: a nine-tailed spirit fox that guards riddles.
SPHYNOX.behaviour: Playful and clever; it hides behind barriers of reasoning.
SPHYNOX.history: It guarded the Tallow family's door for generations.
SPHYNOX.role: Wild MathMon of the Chronos Dimension.

ARITHMORD.concept: Order of operations: a tusked beast that fights with every operation at once.
ARITHMORD.habitat: The deepest Tock Isles - very rare.
ARITHMORD.behaviour: Chaotic until you get the order right; then oddly gentle.
ARITHMORD.relationships: Feared by almost every other MathMon.
ARITHMORD.history: Born, some say, from the Remainder itself.
ARITHMORD.role: Rare wild MathMon of the Chronos Dimension.

EQUINOX_BOSS.concept: Balance: a golden scarab that keeps both sides of everything equal.
EQUINOX_BOSS.habitat: The Guardian's Chamber in the Lost Laboratory.
EQUINOX_BOSS.behaviour: Measured and slow - until Remainder unbalances it.
EQUINOX_BOSS.relationships: Guardian of the Order of the Unknown.
EQUINOX_BOSS.history: Twenty years ago it watched two visitors open the vault.

DIMENSION_DRAGON.concept: Higher dimensions: a dragon folded out of shapes from too many directions.
DIMENSION_DRAGON.behaviour: Its angles stop adding up when the Remainder fills it.
DIMENSION_DRAGON.relationships: Once a friend of the Euclidian builders, who called it Dimensia.
DIMENSION_DRAGON.history: The builders folded it to hold the Remainder - and wrote an apology.

INFINITY_ZERO_BOSS.concept: Infinity and zero: the serpent at the beginning and end of counting.
INFINITY_ZERO_BOSS.habitat: The top of the Time Spire, above the Zero Point.
INFINITY_ZERO_BOSS.behaviour: It changes the rules as the battle goes on.
INFINITY_ZERO_BOSS.relationships: Guardian of the Origin Engine itself.
INFINITY_ZERO_BOSS.history: Older than the four civilisations; they only borrowed it.
INFINITY_ZERO_BOSS.role: Chapter 4 boss: THE INFINITE OVERLORD, filled with all the Remainder Vera gathered.
